definition.title: STEM Learning  (Grades 4-6) - see details
definition.description:
Is your child in Grades 4-6 and curious about how the world works? 

In this 4-week session, your child will dive into the world of Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math through exciting experiments, interactive challenges, and creative problem-solving tasks.

Themes for each week are as follows: 

  • Oct. 3 -  Engineering and Technology 
  • Oct. 10 - Science experiments -exploring chemical reactions (this session is to celebrate Science Literacy Week*)
  • Oct. 17 -  Coding, Logic and Math 
  • Oct. 24 - Data Collection and Hypothesizing 

** Please note these are subject to change* 

Hosted by The Study Buddy, in partnership with Markham Public Library, these free STEM classes encourage kids to think critically, build collaboratively, and discover how everyday ideas spark real-world innovation.

** Note: Please sign up for each week your child is able to attend the class.

registrationInfo.instructionsToAttend:

** Please note: A parent/guardian is to remain inside the library as your child is attending the program. We appreciate your cooperation. 

All the best, 

Markham Public Library

definition.title: Chess Meet Up for Children (drop-in)
definition.description:
Is your child interested in learning how to play chess? CITL is a non-profit student-run organization that aims to promote chess across Canada to players of all skill levels. Through our bi-weekly chess program, CITL provides an environment where children can learn how to play chess.

Details of the program:

  • Takes place in-person at the Milliken Mills Library during the  4th Sunday of each month (except for December 2026, it will be the 2nd Sunday due to the Winter Break)
  • Times/dates that we will be running the sessions: 
    • Sept 27
    • Oct 25
    • Nov 22
    • Dec 13 (** 2nd Sunday)
  • Children ages 6 to 12 years are welcome to join

** As per the library's policy, a parent or guardian is to remain inside the library as your child is in the program. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.**

registrationInfo.instructionsToAttend:
Hello,

You are receiving this email as a confirmation that your child has signed up for the Chess In The Library Program this Sunday March 26th from 3:00-4:00pm at the Unionville Library. 

As per the library's policy regarding children's in-person programs, please note that a parent/guardian is to be in the library when the program is taking place. Thank you for your cooperation and have a great weekend!

All the best,

Markham Public Library

Newcomer Youth Love of Language Club
definition.description:
Calling all newcomer youth between the ages of 6 to 12! Join the Love of Language Club to have fun while practicing your English communication, writing, and reading skills.

In this eight-week program, newcomer youth will improve their English vocabulary through engaging and fun activities, as well as gain confidence and foster friendships with their peers. Each session will explore a new topic, with activities including discussion, games and reading books!

This program is provided in partnership with Youth Assisting Youth. The program will take place in person at the Aaniin Library Program Room. Priority will be given to newcomer youth.

We look forward to seeing you there!
